description: An envelope built to schema 1.x, which names its action tool_name, is refused: tool_name is a field the 2.0 schema does not define, and the refusal names action, the field it was renamed (envelope_schema.json 1.1), which this envelope does not carry (HTL-27 row 225, ruled 2026-11-08; was test_107, which read tool_name as the action).
